answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, while shared timing, messages, and fault proofs link coordinated behavior. When k identities equivocate together, penalties scale as O(k^2), preventing a raven sybil swarm from amortizing misconduct across aliases. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to capital loss, pushing the attack toward its nadir; asymmetric depreciation slows recovery, and willow-linked evidence preserves accountability.
